limitations: Finite controlled checkpoints are explicit fixtures, not autonomous cold starts.
Fewer refused requests do not imply earlier recovery; near-eligibility feeding can delay completed rest.
Twenty-four game hours and four same-valley starts do not establish caloric balance, repeated survival or independent terrain generalization.
Ablation disables positive food associations only, retaining perception/navigation, actual failures and aversion.
Acute thermal danger or desperate thirst without usable observed care can still enter exploration.
Cloud-container resource measurements are not physical laptop/Ollama benchmarks.
